user.title: UniFi Tapo Watchdog
user.description: Log in to your UniFi console (UCG, UDM, UDR). A local account with Network admin rights is enough.

power.description: Kicking does not help when a camera is not on Wi-Fi at all. Pick a switch and the watchdog cuts its power for a moment. Leave empty to only get a notification.
